name: Switch
description: Toggle control with label placement, loading, and helper text.

a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-16 beta->stable: Switch replaced the bespoke GDPR category toggle in CookieConsent; controlled/uncontrolled exclusivity is executable in SwitchProps, and required-story AT plus Chromium forced-colors evidence was recaptured.

checked.description: Checked state for controlled use. Mutually exclusive with defaultChecked.

defaultChecked.description: Initial checked state for uncontrolled use. Mutually exclusive with checked.

disabled.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

loading.description: Shows a loading spinner and blocks interaction; sets aria-busy.

onCheckedChange.description: Called with the next checked value when the switch is toggled.

labelPlacement.description: Where the label sits relative to the control.

helperText.description: Supporting text rendered beneath the control.

error.description: Error message beneath the control; sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby.

forbiddenUse: use Switch inside a form whose values are submitted in a batch.

dense: on/off toggle with immediate effect; label placement right/left/top, sm/md/lg, loading (aria-busy), own helperText + error; onCheckedChange(boolean)

usage.description: Switch is an on/off toggle whose effect applies immediately, like enabling dark mode or notifications. It renders a real button with role=switch, supports label placement, a loading state for async flips, and carries its own helper and error text.

bestPractices.description: Use Switch only when flipping it takes effect immediately; a choice submitted later is a Checkbox.
Label the thing being controlled (Email notifications), never the current state (On).
Use loading while an async toggle is in flight; it sets aria-busy and blocks double flips.
Use helperText for consequences worth knowing before flipping (Applies to all devices).
Do not use a Switch inside a submitted form for consent; that is Checkbox territory.
Do not use negative labels (Disable sounds); keep the label positive so on means yes.

anatomy.name: Track
anatomy.description: The pill background whose color communicates the on/off state.

anatomy.name: Handle
anatomy.description: The sliding thumb; hosts the spinner while loading.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: Visible Label wired via aria-labelledby; placement right, left, or top.

anatomy.name: Helper / error text
anatomy.description: HelperText line under the control; error takes over and announces via role=alert.
